metadata.description: A working suite of Claude Code skills — the portable craft of one developer's workflow, shared to browse and borrow.

plugins.name: skills-suite
plugins.description: 57 skills for portable craft: test-first development, mutation testing, layered review pipelines, decision support, and session-lifecycle helpers. Tier 1-3 from the catalog; the Tier-4 project examples live in examples/ and are not installed.

plugins.name: tldw
plugins.description: /tldw: distill a YouTube video from its transcript into a TL;DR plus the substance, with timestamp links. Pasting a bare YouTube link runs it too.
